sources.entry: Evergreen - Highly-scalable software for libraries that helps library patrons find library materials, and helps libraries manage, catalog, and circulate those materials. (Source Code) GPL-2.0 PLpgSQL

summary.one_liner: Evergreen is a highly scalable integrated library system (ILS) for helping patrons find materials and for helping libraries catalog, manage, and circulate them.
summary.what_it_does: The only README content provided is a pointer to docs/modules/installation/pages/server_installation.adoc, so the README itself is effectively empty and capabilities are taken from the listing description. According to that description, Evergreen lets library patrons search for library materials and lets libraries manage, catalog, and circulate those materials. It is described as highly scalable. The listing names PLpgSQL as the main language, which suggests a PostgreSQL-centered codebase, but the README does not confirm the rest of the stack. Installation details are in the linked server installation guide and are not included here.
use_cases: circulate books and other items to patrons
operate a library system at scale
how_to_run: See docs/modules/installation/pages/server_installation.adoc in the repository for server installation instructions
notable: Integrated library system covering patron search, cataloging, and circulation
caveats: README is only a pointer to the server installation guide; setup details are not in the README text provided
Server installation is required to run it, so it is not a simple desktop tool
